claims.text: Alternatives: clindamycin 300 mg PO BID x7 days or clindamycin ovules 100 mg intravaginally at bedtime x3 days; secnidazole 2 g oral granules, single dose; tinidazole 2 g PO daily x2 days or 1 g daily x5 days
claims.quote: Alternative Regimens Clindamycin 300 mg orally 2 times/day for 7 days or Clindamycin ovules 100 mg intravaginally once at bedtime for 3 days* or Secnidazole 2 g oral granules in a single dose† or Tinidazole 2 g orally once daily for 2 days or Tinidazole 1 g orally once daily for 5 days

claims.text: Clindamycin ovules can weaken latex condoms and diaphragms for 72 h
claims.quote: Clindamycin ovules use an oleaginous base that might weaken latex or rubber products (e.g., condoms and diaphragms). Use of such products within 72 hours after treatment with clindamycin ovules is not recommended.
